purpose: Five evidence-fed product cases for measuring final editorial wheel HP. These are run plans, not pre-scored outputs.

cases.topic: Por qué prodAgentic dejó de pedirle a un generador de imágenes que dibuje diagramas técnicos
source_assertions: prodAgentic routes technical diagrams, architecture schematics, process flows, comparisons, artifact boards and editorial posters to a deterministic renderer.
Only illustration-class visuals are routed to the generative image provider.
The server owns the renderer decision; the browser may rasterize a deterministic SVG layout to PNG but cannot choose renderer authority.
The backend validates PNG signature, SHA-256, dimensions and aspect ratio before accepting the deterministic asset.
review_focus: Does the post explain the architectural decision rather than merely list implementation details?
Does the visual communicate the same idea without generic AI imagery?
Would an engineer learn a reusable design principle from the piece?

cases.topic: El bug de provenance que podía cambiar la evidencia entre Generate Ideas y Select Idea
source_assertions: Evidence-fed idea generation can use a selected immutable SourcePacket through a FactualEnvelope.
The SourcePacket used for idea generation is bound to the idea-selection cycle so a later Evidence Dock change does not silently replace the packet for the selected pipeline run.
If ideas were generated without evidence, attaching a packet later does not retroactively make those ideas evidence-fed.
Idea generation and the selected pipeline use the same FactualEnvelopeBuilder contract.
review_focus: Does storytelling stay factual without inventing a personal incident?
Is the provenance failure mode understandable to a reader outside the codebase?
Does the conclusion expose a reusable engineering invariant?

cases.topic: Un LLM no debería poder aprobar la verdad de su propia respuesta
source_assertions: In prodAgentic, semantic model outputs are proposals and cannot assign authoritative GroundingStatus values.
GroundingAssessmentBuilder deterministically derives claim grounding state from validated claim and evidence relation proposals.
GroundingPolicy blocks contradicted or insufficiently supported factual claims.
Explicit human Grounding verification remains downstream authority before approval.
review_focus: Is the strong position memorable without overstating what LLMs can or cannot do in general?
Does every factual implementation claim stay inside the supplied evidence?
Does the post produce profile curiosity rather than generic AI-safety commentary?

cases.topic: Por qué un botón de Publish no debería ser la autoridad de publicación
source_assertions: prodAgentic requires an immutable approval bundle before publication.
Approval binds the exact final content SHA-256 and, when applicable, the visual asset SHA-256.
Grounding provenance digests are frozen into approval so later content or evidence changes cannot reuse stale factual review.
AI agents do not receive publication authority; explicit human approval remains required.
review_focus: Does the post turn approval immutability into an interesting product or architecture lesson?
Is the distinction between generation, verification and authority clear?
Does it avoid becoming documentation prose?

cases.topic: CI verde son caballos al motor; publish-now quality son caballos a la rueda
source_assertions: prodAgentic keeps factual Trust and editorial Value as separate required properties rather than combining them into one compensating score.
The Value Engine persists angle selection and an advisory Attention Critic snapshot when those stages succeed.
The final product still requires human content review because internal model scores are not publication authority.
CONTENT-DYNO-01 treats missing evidence, missing profile, degraded value stages, required rewrites, incomplete Grounding and missing final visuals as observable drivetrain losses.
review_focus: Does the automotive metaphor clarify the product-quality problem rather than dominate the post?
Can the reader distinguish internal quality sensors from final human publishability?
Would this piece be publishable without manual rewriting?
